#image("/imgs/ap-calc-ab-2007-form-b-frq-02-diagram-01.png", width: 65%)

A particle moves along the $x$-axis so that its velocity $v$ at time $t >= 0$ is given by $v(t)= sin lr((t^(2)))$. The graph of $v$ is shown above for $0 <= t <= sqrt(5 pi)$. The position of the particle at time $t$ is $x(t)$ and its position at time $t = 0$ is $x(0)= 5$.

(a) Find the acceleration of the particle at time $t = 3$.

(b) Find the total distance traveled by the particle from time $t = 0$ to $t = 3$.

(c) Find the position of the particle at time $t = 3$.

(d) For $0 <= t <= sqrt(5 pi)$, find the time $t$ at which the particle is farthest to the right. Explain your answer.
